ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_*_NAME/_DESC 是每把武器的名稱與說明。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SPARKSHOT_DESC.en: A custom part for the Spark Shot. Makes it possible to store a large amount of high-voltage electricity, reducing the time between shots.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SPARKSHOT_DESC.zh-TW: Spark Shot專用的改造零件。可儲存大量高壓電，縮短每次射擊的間隔。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SMG_DESC.en: A custom part for the LE 5 that boosts its effectiveness at long range and when striking weak points.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SMG_DESC.zh-TW: LE 5專用的改造零件，可提升遠距離及命中弱點時的效果。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON2_SMG_DESC.en: A custom part for the LE 5 that greatly boosts its magazine capacity.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON2_SMG_DESC.zh-TW: LE 5專用的改造零件，可大幅提升彈匣容量。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON3_SMG_DESC.en: A custom part for the LE 5 that limits its rate of fire, but converts that bonus to damage instead.

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SHOTGUN_DESC.en: A custom part for all Shotguns. Replaces shells with incendiary rounds that deal more damage and ignite.

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON_SG09_DESC.en: A custom part for the SG-09 R that extends clip capacity to 32 rounds.

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON2_MUP_DESC.en: A custom part for the MUP. Adds a sight that boosts its effectiveness at long range and when striking weak points.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON2_MUP_DESC.zh-TW: MUP專用的改造零件。加裝瞄準器，可提升遠距離及命中弱點時的效果。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ADDON3_MUP_DESC.en: A custom part for the MUP that extends clip capacity to 33 rounds and shortens reload time.

ROB_HUNK_BODY_DESCRIPTION.en:
Specialist is an elite infiltrator who carries a large arsenal of weapons claimed via OSP (on-site procurement).<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Use your Combat Knife against weaker foes to conserve ammo.

< ! > Securing the G-Virus Sample will net you a keycard, allowing you to access weapon cases on each stage.

< ! > Quickstep near an attacking enemy or projectile to Perfect Dodge, then perform a Counterattack with Primary.

< ! > Ammo is scarce, but can be found in opened chests. Secondary stocks and cooldown reduction also affect ammo.

< ! > This is war. Survival is your responsibility.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
特戰專家是一名精英滲透者，攜帶著透過OSP（就地取材）取得的大量武器。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! >對付較弱的敵人時請使用戰鬥小刀，以節省彈藥。

< ! >取得G病毒樣本可獲得一張鑰匙卡，讓你能打開每個關卡中的武器箱。

< ! >在發動攻擊的敵人或投射物附近使用疾步可觸發完美閃避，接著用主要技能發動反擊。

< ! >彈藥相當稀少，但可以在已打開的寶箱中找到。次要技能的充能次數與冷卻時間縮減也會影響彈藥。

< ! >這是戰爭，活下去是你自己的責任。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_LORE.en:
**INT. ABANDONED UMBRELLA FACILITY - NIGHT**


(HUNK, the silent and deadly operative, is locked in a fierce battle with a towering B.O.W. (Bio-Organic Weapon). He deftly dodges a swipe of the creature's massive claw, rolling to his feet and aiming his submachine gun. The B.O.W. roars, charging at HUNK with reckless abandon.)

HUNK: (grunts) Just another day at the office.

(HUNK pulls out a flashbang, tossing it expertly into the B.O.W.'s face. The creature recoils, blinded by the intense light. Taking advantage of the moment, HUNK rushes in, climbing up the B.O.W.'s leg with surprising agility. As he reaches the creature's midsection, he draws his combat knife.)

(Camera cuts to a closeup of the B.O.W.'s horrified face as a loud 'slice!' is heard.)

B.O.W.: RAAAAGHHHHH!!

(A comical slide whistle plays as the B.O.W. crumples to the ground, clutching its crotch. The screen shakes with the impact, and we hear a series of exaggerated sound effects: a car horn honking, a cat yowling, and glass breaking.)

SPECTRE (Voice over comm): (Wincing) I think I felt that one.

(Camera cuts to HUNK, who looks directly into the camera with his signature cold stare.)

HUNK: (deadpan) And they said I'd never make the cut.

(The B.O.W. whimpers, rolling on the ground in agony. A classic 'boing' sound effect is heard.)

B.O.W.: MY... MY REGENERATOR MODULES!!!

(Cut to COMMANDER watching from the command center, his expression one of mixed amusement and exasperation.)

COMMANDER: (sighing) No matter the mission, HUNK always knows how to hit where it hurts.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_LORE.zh-TW:
**內景．廢棄的保護傘公司設施－夜**


（沉默而致命的特工HUNK，正與一頭高大的B.O.W.（生化兵器）激烈交戰。他靈巧地閃過那怪物巨爪的一揮，翻滾起身，舉起衝鋒槍瞄準。B.O.W.發出怒吼，不顧一切地朝HUNK衝了過來。）

HUNK：（悶哼）不過是又一個平凡的上班日。

（HUNK掏出一枚閃光彈，熟練地扔到B.O.W.臉上。怪物被強光刺得睜不開眼，連連後退。HUNK抓準時機衝上前，以驚人的敏捷身手沿著B.O.W.的腿往上爬。爬到怪物的腰腹部時，他拔出了戰鬥小刀。）

（鏡頭切到B.O.W.驚恐的臉部特寫，同時傳來響亮的「唰！」一聲。）

B.O.W.：嗚啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

（滑稽的滑哨音效響起，B.O.W.捂著胯下癱倒在地。畫面隨著撞擊而震動，接著傳來一連串誇張的音效：汽車喇叭聲、貓的慘叫聲，還有玻璃碎裂聲。）

SPECTRE（通訊語音）：（皺眉）我好像也跟著痛了一下。

（鏡頭切到HUNK，他以招牌的冷酷眼神直視鏡頭。）

HUNK：（面無表情）他們還說我不夠「犀利」呢。

（B.O.W.嗚咽著，痛苦地在地上打滾。此時響起經典的「boing」彈簧音效。）

B.O.W.：我的……我的再生模組！！！

（切到在指揮中心觀看的司令官，他的表情既好笑又無奈。）

司令官：（嘆氣）不管是什麼任務，HUNK總是知道該怎麼直擊「要害」。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so he vanished, human unit now killed.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是他就這樣消逝了，人類單位如今已陣亡（Human Unit Now Killed）。

ROB_ARTIFACT_PURSUER_DESC.zh-TW: 玩家開局時持有一枚S.T.A.R.S.徽章。

ROB_ARTIFACT_CONTAMINATION_DESC.en: Each player gets a random Virus event each stage.

ROB_ARTIFACT_STRIKETEAM_DESC.en: Players will occasionally have Strike Teams sent in to neutralize them.

ROB_HUNK_BODY_RANDOMPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 初始擁有<style=cIsDamage>LE 5</style>與<style=cIsDamage>副武器</style>。你可以<style=cIsDamage>翻找</style><style=cIsUtility>寶箱</style>來取得彈藥。<style=cIsHealth>所有武器箱的內容物皆為隨機。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOTGUNPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Start with <style=cIsHealth>ONLY</style> a <style=cIsDamage>W-870</style>. You can <style=cIsDamage>rummage</style> through <style=cIsUtility>chests</style> for ammo.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOTGUNPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 初始<style=cIsHealth>只</style>擁有一把<style=cIsDamage>W-870</style>。你可以<style=cIsDamage>翻找</style><style=cIsUtility>寶箱</style>來取得彈藥。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SMGPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Start with <style=cIsHealth>ONLY</style> a <style=cIsDamage>fully upgraded LE 5</style>. You can <style=cIsDamage>rummage</style> through <style=cIsUtility>chests</style> for ammo. <style=cIsDamage>Special</style> is replaced with <color=#C80202>Mayhem Mode</color>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SMGPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 初始<style=cIsHealth>只</style>擁有一把<style=cIsDamage>完全升級的LE 5</style>。你可以<style=cIsDamage>翻找</style><style=cIsUtility>寶箱</style>來取得彈藥。<style=cIsDamage>特殊技能</style>會被替換為<color=#C80202>狂暴模式</color>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_WPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Start with <style=cIsHealth>ONLY</style> a <style=cIsDamage>sidearm</style>. You can <style=cIsDamage>rummage</style> through <style=cIsUtility>chests</style> for ammo. <style=cIsDamage>Utility</style> is replaced with <color=#C80202>Uroboros</color>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_WPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 初始<style=cIsHealth>只</style>擁有<style=cIsDamage>副武器</style>。你可以<style=cIsDamage>翻找</style><style=cIsUtility>寶箱</style>來取得彈藥。<style=cIsDamage>輔助技能</style>會被替換為<color=#C80202>銜尾蛇</color>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_FLAMERPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Start with <style=cIsHealth>ONLY</style> a <style=cIsDamage>Chemical Flamethrower</style>. You can <style=cIsDamage>rummage</style> through <style=cIsUtility>chests</style> for ammo. <style=cIsHealth>Only ONE weapon case spawns per stage.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_FLAMERPASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 初始<style=cIsHealth>只</style>擁有一把<style=cIsDamage>化學火焰噴射器</style>。你可以<style=cIsDamage>翻找</style><style=cIsUtility>寶箱</style>來取得彈藥。<style=cIsHealth>每個關卡只會生成一個武器箱。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_PRIMARY_KNIFE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>搜刮。</style><style=cIsDamage>揮砍</style>近距離的敵人，造成<style=cIsDamage>200%傷害</style>，並施加<style=cIsHealth>撕裂</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_PRIMARY_CQC_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Looting.</style> <style=cIsDamage>Kick twice</style> for <style=cIsDamage>200% and 250% damage</style>. If the <style=cIsUtility>second kick</style> connects, follow up with a <style=cIsDamage>Counterattack</style>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_PRIMARY_CQC_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>搜刮。</style><style=cIsDamage>連踢兩腳</style>，造成<style=cIsDamage>200%與250%傷害</style>。若<style=cIsUtility>第二腳</style>命中，可接著發動<style=cIsDamage>反擊</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_SCANNER_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 掃描<style=cIsUtility>尚未打開的武器箱</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_HOOKSHOT_DESCRIPTION.en: Shoot a hook to a <style=cIsUtility>distant point</style>, then <style=cIsUtility>reel yourself in</style>. <style=cIsDamage>You can counterattack after landing.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_HOOKSHOT_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 向<style=cIsUtility>遠處的定點</style>射出鉤爪，然後<style=cIsUtility>把自己拉過去</style>。<style=cIsDamage>落地後可以發動反擊。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_ATM_DESCRIPTION.en: Shoot for <style=cIsDamage>8000% damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Deals most damage on direct hits.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_ATM_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 射擊造成<style=cIsDamage>8000%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>直接命中時傷害最高。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_ATM2_DESCRIPTION.en: Shoot for <style=cIsDamage>8000% damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Deals most damage on direct hits.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_ATM2_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 射擊造成<style=cIsDamage>8000%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>直接命中時傷害最高。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_RPG_DESCRIPTION.en: Shoot for <style=cIsDamage>8000% damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Deals most damage on direct hits.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_RPG_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 射擊造成<style=cIsDamage>8000%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>直接命中時傷害最高。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_FLAMETHROWER_DESCRIP.en: Shoot a stream of flame for <style=cIsDamage>tons of damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Ignites.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_FLAMETHROWER_DESCRIP.zh-TW: 噴射火焰造成<style=cIsDamage>大量傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>點燃。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_SPARKSHOT_DESCRIPTIO.en: Shoot an electrified needle for <style=cIsDamage>1000% damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Arcs to up to 3 enemies for <style=cIsDamage>2000% damage</style>.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_SPARKSHOT_DESCRIPTIO.zh-TW: 射出一根帶電的針，造成<style=cIsDamage>1000%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>電弧最多可跳躍至3名敵人，造成<style=cIsDamage>2000%傷害</style>。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_MINIGUN_DESCRIPTION.en: Shoot for <style=cIsDamage>2x250% damage</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Damage scales with attack speed.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SHOOT_MINIGUN_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 射擊造成<style=cIsDamage>2x250%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>傷害隨攻擊速度提升。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SECONDARY_AIM_DESCRIPTION.en: Take aim, <style=cIsUtility>exposing enemy weak points</style>. <style=cIsDamage>Using primary while aiming fires your held gun.</style>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SECONDARY_AIM_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 舉槍瞄準，<style=cIsUtility>暴露敵人的弱點</style>。<style=cIsDamage>瞄準時使用主要技能可用手上的槍開火。</style>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_DODGE_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Dash</style> a short distance. If used preemptively to <style=cIsUtility>avoid an attack</style>, perform a <style=cIsDamage>Perfect Dodge</style>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_DODGE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>衝刺</style>一小段距離。若搶先使用並<style=cIsUtility>躲開攻擊</style>，則發動<style=cIsDamage>完美閃避</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_DODGE_SCEPTER_DESC.en:
<style=cIsUtility>Dash</style> a short distance. If used preemptively to <style=cIsUtility>avoid an attack</style>, perform a <style=cIsDamage>Perfect Dodge</style>.
<color=#d299ff>SCEPTER: The power of Uroboros flows through you.</color>
ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_DODGE_SCEPTER_DESC.zh-TW:
<style=cIsUtility>衝刺</style>一小段距離。若搶先使用並<style=cIsUtility>躲開攻擊</style>，則發動<style=cIsDamage>完美閃避</style>。
<color=#d299ff>權杖：銜尾蛇的力量在你體內流動。</color>

ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_PARRY_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Block</style> an attack, <style=cIsDamage>negating</style> damage and <style=cIsUtility>refunding the cooldown</style>. If used preemptively, perform a <style=cIsDamage>Perfect Parry</style>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_PARRY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>格擋</style>一次攻擊，<style=cIsDamage>抵銷</style>傷害並<style=cIsUtility>返還冷卻時間</style>。若搶先使用，則發動<style=cIsDamage>完美招架</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_BASH_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Bash</style> nearby enemies, <style=cIsUtility>stunning them</style> for <style=cIsDamage>400% damage</style>. If used preemptively to <style=cIsUtility>cancel an attack</style>, perform a <style=cIsDamage>Perfect Bash</style>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_UTILITY_BASH_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>衝撞</style>附近的敵人，<style=cIsUtility>使其眩暈</style>並造成<style=cIsDamage>400%傷害</style>。若搶先使用並<style=cIsUtility>打斷攻擊</style>，則發動<style=cIsDamage>完美肩撞</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_SPECIAL_SWAP_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Swap</style> to a different <style=cIsDamage>gun</style>. Tap to swap to your <style=cIsUtility>last held gun</style>.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_SPECIAL_SWAP_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>切換</style>至另一把<style=cIsDamage>槍</style>。輕按可切換至<style=cIsUtility>上一把手持的槍</style>。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION.en: A standard military-grade knife. Sure to come in handy in a pinch.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 標準的軍用小刀。緊要關頭肯定派得上用場。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_INFINITE_DESCRIPTION.en: A specially-treated military-grade knife that's been hardened to an unbelievable degree. They say it's been made to really last.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_INFINITE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 經過特殊處理的軍用小刀，硬度強化到令人難以置信的程度。據說做得非常耐用。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_HIDDEN_DESCRIPTION.en: A low profile retractable blade hidden in the sleeve. Ideal for stealth operations.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_HIDDEN_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 藏在袖子裡的低調伸縮刀刃。非常適合潛行任務。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_WESKER_DESCRIPTION.en: A vicious blade with a serrated edge to aid in tearing up your opponents.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_WESKER_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 帶有鋸齒刀鋒的兇狠利刃，有助於將對手撕成碎片。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_MACHETE_DESCRIPTION.en: A huge blade meant primarily for guerrilla tactics.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_MACHETE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 主要用於遊擊戰術的巨大刀刃。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_RE4_DESCRIPTION.en: A knife forged with infinite possibilities.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_RE4_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 以無限可能性鍛造而成的小刀。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_BLOODY_DESCRIPTION.en: A bloodied blade with a serrated edge that has torn up many opponents.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_BLOODY_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 沾滿鮮血的鋸齒利刃，曾將許多對手撕成碎片。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_HOTDOGGER_DESCRIPTIO.en: As its name implies, this Umbrella-developed anti-bioweapon knife is used by those who like to show off.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_HOTDOGGER_DESCRIPTIO.zh-TW: 顧名思義，這把由保護傘公司開發的反生化兵器小刀，是給愛現的人用的。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_STUNROD_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 免責聲明：實際上並不會造成眩暈。

ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_KITCHEN_DESCRIPTION.en: A knife made for cooking. Its edge chips easily.
ROB_HUNK_BODY_KNIFE_KITCHEN_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 烹飪用的刀。刀刃很容易缺角。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_COMPLETION_UNLOCKAB.en: As HUNK, beat the game or obliterate.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_COMPLETION_UNLOCKAB.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，通關遊戲或抹除自己。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_MONSOON_UNLOCKABLE_.en: As HUNK, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_MONSOON_UNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，在季風難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_TYPHOON_UNLOCKABLE_.en:
As HUNK, beat the game or obliterate on Typhoon or Eclipse.
<color=#8888>(Counts any difficulty Typhoon or higher)</color>
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_TYPHOON_UNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW:
作為HUNK，在颱風或日食難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。
<color=#8888>（颱風以上的任何難度皆計入）</color>

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_SUPPORTER_ACHIEVEME.en: Play HUNK before his official release.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_SUPPORTER_ACHIEVEME.zh-TW: 在HUNK正式發佈前使用他遊玩。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_LIGHTWEIGHT_ACHIEVE.en:
As HUNK, clear stage 1 with no items.
<color=#8888>(Guns and tools are not counted against you)</color>
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_LIGHTWEIGHT_ACHIEVE.zh-TW:
作為HUNK，在沒有任何物品的情況下通過第1關。
<color=#8888>（槍枝與工具不列入計算）</color>

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_GUERRILLA_ACHIEVEME.en: As HUNK, obtain a full arsenal.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_GUERRILLA_ACHIEVEME.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，取得完整的軍火庫。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_ROOKIE_ACHIEVEMENT_.en: HUNK: First Day on the Job
As HUNK, obtain a new weapon.

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_SWAT_ACHIEVEMENT_ID.en: As HUNK, fully upgrade the MUP.

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_CQC_ACHIEVEMENT_ID_.en: As HUNK, perform 10 successful counterattacks on one stage.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_CQC_ACHIEVEMENT_ID_.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，在單一關卡中成功發動10次反擊。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_INFINITEKNIFE_ACHIE.en: As HUNK, carry two Spade Keycards at once.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_INFINITEKNIFE_ACHIE.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，同時攜帶兩張黑桃鑰匙卡。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_WESKERKNIFE_UNLOCKA.en: As HUNK, upgrade a weapon with a new attachment.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_WESKERKNIFE_UNLOCKA.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，用新的配件升級一把武器。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_MACHETE_UNLOCKABLE_.en: HUNK: Don't Need No Stinkin' Gun
As HUNK, complete a stage without firing any guns.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_MACHETE_UNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，在一槍都沒開的情況下完成一個關卡。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_HOTDOGGER_ACHIEVEME.en: As HUNK, obtain the Chemical Flamethrower.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_HOTDOGGER_ACHIEVEME.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，取得化學火焰噴射器。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_STUNROD_ACHIEVEMENT.en: As HUNK, obtain the Spark Shot.

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_FLAMER_ACHIEVEMENT_.en: As HUNK, fully upgrade the Chemical Flamethrower.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_FLAMER_ACHIEVEMENT_.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，將化學火焰噴射器完全升級。

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_SURVIVALKIT_ACHIEVE.en: As HUNK, run out of ammo on Commencement.

ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_JUMPPACK_ACHIEVEMEN.en: HUNK: Nowhere to Go but Up
As HUNK, fall victim to a skydiving accident.
ACHIEVEMENT_ROB_HUNK_JUMPPACK_ACHIEVEMEN.zh-TW: 作為HUNK，不幸遭遇跳傘意外。

ROB_HUNK_CONTAMINATION_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC.en: Turn in a virus sample to Umbrella Corporation.
ROB_HUNK_CONTAMINATION_ACHIEVEMENT_DESC.zh-TW: 向保護傘公司繳交一份病毒樣本。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsDamage>Dealing damage</style> stores <style=cIsHealth>Biomass</style>, boosting your <style=cIsDamage>damage</style> when full. Jumps can be <style=cIsDamage>charged</style> for <style=cIsUtility>mighty leaps</style>.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsDamage>造成傷害</style>可儲存<style=cIsHealth>生物質</style>，儲滿時提升你的<style=cIsDamage>傷害</style>。跳躍可以<style=cIsDamage>蓄力</style>，進行<style=cIsUtility>強力飛躍</style>。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE2_DESCRIPTION.en: The Nemesis T-Type can <style=cIsHealth>mutate</style> by consuming <style=cIsDamage>persons of interest</style>, gaining <style=cIsDamage>new and upgraded abilities</style>.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE2_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 追跡者T型可以透過吞噬<style=cIsDamage>關鍵人物</style>來<style=cIsHealth>突變</style>，獲得<style=cIsDamage>全新與強化的能力</style>。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE22_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsUtility>Melee attacks</style> deal <style=cIsDamage>20%</style> more damage, <style=isHealth>BUT allies can take damage</style>.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_PASSIVE22_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>近戰攻擊</style>造成的傷害提高<style=cIsDamage>20%</style>，<style=isHealth>但盟友也會受到傷害</style>。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_MELEE_DESCRIPTION.en: Punch for <style=cIsDamage>350% damage</style>. Use while <style=cIsUtility>standing still</style> to stomp for <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style>. Use while <style=cIsUtility>sprinting</style> to tackle for <style=cIsDamage>600% damage</style>.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_MELEE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 揮拳造成<style=cIsDamage>350%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>站立不動</style>時使用會改為踐踏，造成<style=cIsDamage>800%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>奔跑</style>時使用會改為衝撞，造成<style=cIsDamage>600%傷害</style>。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_GRAB_DESCRIPTION.en: Grab an enemy. Use Primary to consume them and heal 10% max health, or Secondary to charge a throw for up to 2400% damage.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_GRAB_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 抓住一名敵人。使用主要技能可將其吞噬並恢復10%最大生命值，使用次要技能則可蓄力投擲，最多造成2400%傷害。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_DASH_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 在<style=cIsUtility>空中</style>使用可進行<style=cIsDamage>一次</style>空中衝刺。

ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_ULTIMATE_DESCRIPTION.en: Hold to slowly consume <style=cIsHealth>Biomass</style>, restoring up to <style=cIsHealing>100% max health</style>.
ROB_NEMESIS_BODY_ULTIMATE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 按住可緩慢消耗<style=cIsHealth>生物質</style>，最多恢復<style=cIsHealing>100%最大生命值</style>。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BACKUPMAG.en: Gain <color=#00FF66>Fake Ammo</color> after a successful reload.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BACKUPMAG.zh-TW: 成功上彈後獲得<color=#00FF66>虛擬彈藥</color>。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BANDOLIER.en: Ammo packs refill your magazine with <color=#00FF66>Fake Ammo</color>.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BANDOLIER.zh-TW: 彈藥包會以<color=#00FF66>虛擬彈藥</color>補滿你的彈匣。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_ALIENHEAD.en: Gain <style=cIsUtility>more ammo</style> when picking any up.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_ALIENHEAD.zh-TW: 拾取彈藥時可獲得<style=cIsUtility>更多彈藥</style>。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BRAINSTALKS.en: While active, firing your gun <style=cIsUtility>consumes no ammo</style>.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_BRAINSTALKS.zh-TW: 效果持續期間，開槍<style=cIsUtility>不消耗彈藥</style>。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_LYSATECELL.en: Gain <color=#00FF66>Fake Ammo</color> when equipping a weapon.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_LYSATECELL.zh-TW: 裝備武器時獲得<color=#00FF66>虛擬彈藥</color>。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_PURITY.en: Double your <style=cIsUtility>magazine size</style>. Ammo consumption is unchanged.
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_PURITY.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>彈匣容量</style>加倍。彈藥消耗量不變。

ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_LUMINOUSSHOT.en: Gain a stack after aiming for <style=cIsUtility>1 second</style>. <style=cIsHealth>Lose all stacks when you shoot or stop aiming.</style>
ROB_HUNK_ITEM_EFFECT_LUMINOUSSHOT.zh-TW: 瞄準<style=cIsUtility>1秒</style>後獲得一層。<style=cIsHealth>射擊或停止瞄準時會失去所有層數。</style>

ROB_NEMESIS_ITEM_EFFECT_ALIENHEAD.zh-TW: 提升<style=cIsDamage>吞噬</style>敵人時獲得的<style=cIsHealth>生物質</style>。

ROB_HUNK_JETPACK_DESC.en: An Umbrella-made tool that allows you to boost yourself in any direction by pressing jump while midair.
ROB_HUNK_JETPACK_DESC.zh-TW: 保護傘公司製造的工具，在空中按下跳躍鍵即可朝任意方向推進。

ROB_HUNK_SURVIVALKIT_DESC.en: A survival kit that boosts both your ability to rummage for ammo and the effectiveness of your knife.
ROB_HUNK_SURVIVALKIT_DESC.zh-TW: 一組求生包，可同時提升你翻找彈藥的能力與小刀的威力。

ROB_HUNK_TRANSCEIVER_DESC.en: Calls in a squadmate to help you on your operation.
ROB_HUNK_TRANSCEIVER_DESC.zh-TW: 呼叫一名隊友前來協助你的行動。

ROB_HUNK_INFROCKET_DESC.en: A rocket launcher with <style=cIsHealing>infinite ammo</style>. Reward for the <color=#FFFF00>Early Supporter</color> achievement.
ROB_HUNK_INFROCKET_DESC.zh-TW: 擁有<style=cIsHealing>無限彈藥</style>的火箭筒。<color=#FFFF00>早期支持者</color>成就的獎勵。

ROB_HUNK_KEYCARD_DESC.zh-TW: 用來打開<color=#C80202>保護傘公司</color>的<style=cIsUtility>武器箱</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYCARD_MASTER_DESC.en: Used to open <color=#C80202>Umbrella Corporation</color> <style=cIsUtility>weapon cases</style>. Opens <style=cIsHealing>all cases</style>, and turns other keycards into <style=cIsUtility>scrap</style>.
ROB_HUNK_KEYCARD_MASTER_DESC.zh-TW: 用來打開<color=#C80202>保護傘公司</color>的<style=cIsUtility>武器箱</style>。可打開<style=cIsHealing>所有武器箱</style>，並將其他鑰匙卡變成<style=cIsUtility>碎片</style>。

ROB_HUNK_WRISTBAND_DESC.en: An electronic key for use in <color=#C80202>Umbrella Corporation</color> facilities. Used to open a <style=cIsUtility>special weapon case</style>.
ROB_HUNK_WRISTBAND_DESC.zh-TW: 在<color=#C80202>保護傘公司</color>設施內使用的電子鑰匙。用來打開<style=cIsUtility>特殊武器箱</style>。

ROB_HUNK_TYPEWRITER_DESC.en: Gain <style=cIsUtility>2</style> additional <color=#C80202>Umbrella Corporation</color> <style=cIsUtility>weapon cases</style> per stage.
ROB_HUNK_TYPEWRITER_DESC.zh-TW: 每個關卡額外獲得<style=cIsUtility>2</style>個<color=#C80202>保護傘公司</color>的<style=cIsUtility>武器箱</style>。

ROB_HUNK_CRYSTALSKULL_DESC.en: A rare treasure. Can be turned into any <style=cIsUtility>Cauldron</style> to receive one item.
ROB_HUNK_CRYSTALSKULL_DESC.zh-TW: 稀有的寶物。可交給任意一口<style=cIsUtility>大鍋</style>以換取一件物品。

ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE_DESC.en: A special badge for R.P.D.'s special forces division, <color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color> <style=cIsHealth>Maybe picking this up was a bad idea?</style>
ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE_DESC.zh-TW: R.P.D.特種部隊<color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color>的特殊徽章。<style=cIsHealth>撿起這個說不定是個壞主意？</style>

ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE_DESCFULL.en: Each stage, a special <color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color> box spawns that can only be opened using this badge. However, the <style=cIsHealth>Nemesis T-Type</style> will relentlessly hunt you down.
ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE_DESCFULL.zh-TW: 每個關卡會生成一個只能用這枚徽章打開的特殊<color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color>裝備箱。然而，<style=cIsHealth>追跡者T型</style>將會對你窮追不捨。

ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE2_DESC.en: Used to access a <style=cIsUtility>special chest</style> on each stage.
ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE2_DESC.zh-TW: 用來打開每個關卡中的<style=cIsUtility>特殊寶箱</style>。

ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE2_DESCFULL.en: Each stage, a special <color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color> box spawns that can only be opened using this badge. However, the <style=cIsHealth>Nemesis T-Type</style> will relentlessly hunt you down.
ROB_HUNK_STARSBADGE2_DESCFULL.zh-TW: 每個關卡會生成一個只能用這枚徽章打開的特殊<color=#F20443>S.T.A.R.S.</color>裝備箱。然而，<style=cIsHealth>追跡者T型</style>將會對你窮追不捨。

ROB_HUNK_G_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.en: Volatile sample of the <color=#C678B4>Golgotha Virus</color>. <style=cIsHealth>Handle with care.</style>
ROB_HUNK_G_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.zh-TW: 不穩定的<color=#C678B4>Golgotha病毒</color>樣本。<style=cIsHealth>請小心處理。</style>

ROB_HUNK_T_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.en: Volatile sample of the <color=#0066FF>Tyrant Virus</color>. <style=cIsHealth>Handle with care.</style>
ROB_HUNK_T_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.zh-TW: 不穩定的<color=#0066FF>暴君病毒</color>樣本。<style=cIsHealth>請小心處理。</style>

ROB_HUNK_C_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.en: Volatile sample of the <color=#FF0033>Chrysalid Virus</color>. <style=cIsHealth>Handle with care.</style>
ROB_HUNK_C_VIRUS_SAMPLE_DESC.zh-TW: 不穩定的<color=#FF0033>Chrysalid病毒</color>樣本。<style=cIsHealth>請小心處理。</style>

ROB_HUNK_URO_SAMPLE_DESC.en: Volatile sample of the <color=#140E0E>Uroboros Virus</color>. <style=cIsHealth>Handle with care.</style>
ROB_HUNK_URO_SAMPLE_DESC.zh-TW: 不穩定的<color=#140E0E>銜尾蛇病毒</color>樣本。<style=cIsHealth>請小心處理。</style>

ROB_HUNK_PLAGAS_SAMPLE_DESC.en: Volatile sample of the <color=#C678B4>Plagas</color>. <style=cIsHealth>Handle with care.</style>
ROB_HUNK_PLAGAS_SAMPLE_DESC.zh-TW: 不穩定的<color=#C678B4>普拉卡</color>樣本。<style=cIsHealth>請小心處理。</style>

ROB_HUNK_CASE_INSPECT_DESC.en: Case containing a new weapon for HUNK. Requires a specific keycard to open.
ROB_HUNK_CASE_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 裝有HUNK新武器的箱子。需要特定的鑰匙卡才能打開。

ROB_HUNK_SPECIALCASE_INSPECT_DESC.en: Special case containing a powerful new weapon for HUNK. Requires a certain level of security clearance to open.
ROB_HUNK_SPECIALCASE_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 裝有HUNK強力新武器的特殊箱子。需要一定等級的安全權限才能打開。

ROB_HUNK_STARSBOX_INSPECT_DESC.en: Special box containing powerful gear for S.T.A.R.S. members. Requires a badge to open.
ROB_HUNK_STARSBOX_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 裝有S.T.A.R.S.隊員專用強力裝備的特殊箱子。需要徽章才能打開。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPONBOX_INSPECT_DESC.en: A weapon case with useful stuff inside.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPONBOX_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 裡面裝著實用物資的武器箱。

ROB_HUNK_LOOTBOX_INSPECT_DESC.en: An Umbrella-branded case with useful stuff inside.
ROB_HUNK_LOOTBOX_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 印有保護傘公司標誌的箱子，裡面裝著實用物資。

ROB_HUNK_TERMINAL_INSPECT_DESC.en: Used to send virus samples to Umbrella Corporation. Turned in samples are rewarded appropriately.
ROB_HUNK_TERMINAL_INSPECT_DESC.zh-TW: 用來將病毒樣本傳送給保護傘公司。繳交樣本可獲得相應的獎勵。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_LOOTING.en: <style=cKeywordName>Looting</style><style=cSub>Enemies slain with this skill have a small chance to drop ammo.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_LOOTING.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>搜刮</style><style=cSub>以此技能擊敗的敵人有小機率掉落彈藥。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_MANGLED.en: <style=cKeywordName>Mangled</style><style=cSub>Upon reaching 6 stacks of this debuff, enemies suffer an instant <style=cIsDamage>2200% damage</style>.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_MANGLED.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>撕裂</style><style=cSub>此減益效果疊加至6層時，敵人會立即受到<style=cIsDamage>2200%傷害</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTDODGE.en: <style=cKeywordName>Perfect Dodge</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>Refund cooldown</style> and become briefly invulnerable. Allows you to perform a <style=cIsDamage>Counterattack</style>.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTDODGE.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>完美閃避</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>返還冷卻時間</style>並短暫無敵。可讓你發動<style=cIsDamage>反擊</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTPARRY.en: <style=cKeywordName>Perfect Parry</style><style=cSub>Deal <style=cIsDamage>800% damage</style> and become briefly invulnerable. Allows you to perform a <style=cIsDamage>Counterattack</style>.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTPARRY.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>完美招架</style><style=cSub>造成<style=cIsDamage>800%傷害</style>並短暫無敵。可讓你發動<style=cIsDamage>反擊</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTBASH.en: <style=cKeywordName>Perfect Bash</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>Refund cooldown</style> and become briefly invulnerable. Allows you to perform a <style=cIsDamage>Counterattack</style>.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_PERFECTBASH.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>完美肩撞</style><style=cSub><style=cIsUtility>返還冷卻時間</style>並短暫無敵。可讓你發動<style=cIsDamage>反擊</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_COUNTER.en: <style=cKeywordName>Counterattack</style><style=cSub>Pressing <style=cIsDamage>primary</style> lunges and performs a lethal <style=cIsDamage>counterattack</style> on a nearby enemy.
ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_COUNTER.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>反擊</style><style=cSub>按下<style=cIsDamage>主要技能</style>會向前突進，並對附近一名敵人發動致命的<style=cIsDamage>反擊</style>。

ROB_HUNK_KEYWORD_VIRUS.en:
<style=cKeywordName>G-Virus</style><style=cSub>Once every stage, a random monster becomes <color=#C678B4>Infected</color>. It mutates, <style=cIsHealth>growing stronger over time</style>, and killing it drops a <color=#FFFF00>G-Virus Sample</color>.

<style=cKeywordName>T-Virus</style><style=cSub>Once every stage, several monsters become <color=#0066FF>Infected</color>. This <style=cIsHealth>revives</style> them twice, and killing all of them nets you a <color=#FFFF00>T-Virus Sample</color>.

<style=cKeywordName>C病毒</style><style=cSub>每個關卡一次，數隻怪物會遭到<color=#FF0033>感染</color>。這些怪物死亡時會陷入<style=cIsDamage>狂熱狀態</style>，<style=cIsUtility>5</style>秒後<style=cIsHealth>爆炸</style>，將它們全數擊敗即可獲得一份<color=#FFFF00>C病毒樣本</color>。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_RAILGUN_NAME.zh-TW: 鐵磁式步兵用次世代磁軌炮

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM2_DESC.en: A recoilless rocket launcher that fires 84mm projectiles. The piercing power of the rocket causes more damage than the explosion.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM2_DESC.zh-TW: 發射84mm彈藥的無後座力火箭筒。火箭的穿透力造成的傷害比爆炸本身更高。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_FLAMETHROWER_DESC.en: An Umbrella-made weapon that uses pressurized gas to produce red-hot flames. Portable and refuellable, it's always ready for the long haul.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_FLAMETHROWER_DESC.zh-TW: 保護傘公司製造的武器，利用加壓氣體噴出熾熱的火焰。便於攜帶又可補充燃料，隨時能應付持久戰。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SHIELD_DESC.en: Blocks the bullshit fuck ass laser.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SHIELD_DESC.zh-TW: 用來擋那道該死的破雷射。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SPARKSHOT_DESC.en: A high-voltage gun for use on test animals. Charging takes a while and the needles' wires snap easily, but it also really packs a punch.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SPARKSHOT_DESC.zh-TW: 用於實驗動物的高壓電擊槍。充電需要一段時間，針上的導線也容易斷，不過威力十足。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_AR_DESC.en: A rifle capable of fully automatic fire.

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM_DESC.en: An unlimited recoilless rocket launcher. Lightweight and easy to handle, this weapon has a lot of power.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM_DESC.zh-TW: 彈藥無限的無後座力火箭筒。輕巧又容易操控，而且威力強大。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_GRAPPLEGUN_DESC.en: Shoots a grapple hook attached to a zip-line that allows you to propel yourself to any desired location.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_GRAPPLEGUN_DESC.zh-TW: 射出連著滑索的鉤爪，讓你把自己拉往任何想去的位置。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MGL_DESC.en: A semi-auto grenade launcher prototype capable of firing explosive rounds.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MGL_DESC.zh-TW: 半自動榴彈發射器的原型，可發射爆裂彈。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_RPG_DESC.en: A rocket launcher with devastating power.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_RPG_DESC.zh-TW: 擁有毀滅性威力的火箭筒。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_GRENADELAUNCHER_DESC.en: A single-round break-action grenade launcher capable of firing flame rounds.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_GRENADELAUNCHER_DESC.zh-TW: 單發折開式榴彈發射器，可發射燃燒彈。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_REVOLVER_DESC.en: An old-fashioned revolver that uses magnum rounds.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_REVOLVER_DESC.zh-TW: 使用麥格農子彈的老式左輪手槍。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_RAILGUN_DESC.en: A portable rail cannon developed by Cornell Garner and the U.S. military in order to eliminate bioweapons in case of an outbreak.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_RAILGUN_DESC.zh-TW: 由Cornell Garner與美軍共同開發的可攜式磁軌炮，用來在疫情爆發時消滅生化兵器。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_BLUEROSE_DESC.en: A six-chamber revolver that fires two shots at a time? What kinda whackjob thinks up something like that?
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_BLUEROSE_DESC.zh-TW: 一次發射兩發子彈的六發左輪？到底是哪個瘋子想出這種東西？

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ROCKETLAUNCHER_DESC.en: A rocket launcher with devastating power.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ROCKETLAUNCHER_DESC.zh-TW: 擁有毀滅性威力的火箭筒。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MAGNUM_DESC.en: An easy-to-handle magnum with high power.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MAGNUM_DESC.zh-TW: 容易操控的高威力麥格農手槍。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MINIGUN_DESC.en: A six-barrel motorized minigun that fires 7.62mm NATO rounds. Incredibly fast rate of fire and deals a lot of damage.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_MINIGUN_DESC.zh-TW: 六管電動轉輪機槍，發射7.62mm北約彈。射速快得驚人，傷害也非常高。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SG09_DESC.en: An easy-to-use handgun with a high ammo capacity.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SG09_DESC.zh-TW: 容易上手、載彈量高的手槍。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_M19_DESC.en: A powerful handgun with a built-in laser sight.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_M19_DESC.zh-TW: 內建雷射瞄準器的強力手槍。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SCANNER_DESC.en: A device capable of locating certain electronics.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_SCANNER_DESC.zh-TW: 能夠定位特定電子設備的裝置。

ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM4_DESC.en: A recoilless rocket launcher that fires 84mm projectiles. The piercing power of the rocket causes more damage than the explosion.
ROB_HUNK_WEAPON_ATM4_DESC.zh-TW: 發射84mm彈藥的無後座力火箭筒。火箭的穿透力造成的傷害比爆炸本身更高。

Solid <style=cIsDamage>all-rounder</styl.zh-TW: 可靠的<style=cIsDamage>全能型</style>武器，<style=cIsUtility>彈藥消耗划算</style>。

<style=cIsDamage>Heavy hits</style>, but.en: <style=cIsDamage>Heavy hits</style>, but <style=cIsHealth>poor ammo economy</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Comes with a built-in Laser Sight.</style>
<style=cIsDamage>Heavy hits</style>, but.zh-TW: <style=cIsDamage>威力強大</style>，但<style=cIsHealth>彈藥消耗不划算</style>。<style=cIsUtility>內建雷射瞄準器。</style>
